register.region: a protected place of residence; checked so no region is left out
register.age: deciding by age would be direct discrimination; audited
register.gender: deciding by gender would be direct discrimination; audited
register.disability: health data, sensitive under the PDPL; audited, never used to decide
register.months_unemployed: registered fact the service exists to act on; caseworkers can explain it
register.digital_skills: assessed at registration for the service; explains need for coaching
register.education: registered fact relevant to job search
register.prior_jobs: registered fact relevant to job search
register.has_licence: registered fact that affects which jobs are reachable
register.distance_km: distance to the office, relevant to attending coaching
register.prior_wage_k: carries past pay gaps by gender and region (historical bias)
register.dependants: family data collected for benefits, not for coaching (purpose limitation)
register.motivation: a caseworker's rating: subjective, and seekers would learn to game it
register.risk_score: a model output built partly from age and disability; it would bring them back in
